title: FBI-UAP-D016, Digital Rendering, Narrative Statement 2-1, Western United States Event, 2023

pages.image_type: color digital illustration / composite night scene
pages.description: A nighttime landscape scene showing two human figures in silhouette standing in the foreground, viewed from behind, their outlines traced with a faint yellowish glow. Both figures appear to be standing with arms at their sides facing away toward a distant terrain. Behind them is a range of low, rolling desert-like hills or mountains rendered in dark brown tones. The upper portion of the image is a deep blue star-filled night sky scattered with numerous small white points of light. A single bright, glowing yellow-white spherical object sits in the right portion of the sky above the horizon, larger and more luminous than the surrounding stars. The overall lighting is dark and shadowy.
